Technology / Launch infrastructure

Test on the ground.
Learn for flight.

TB30 is the launch table that holds Starlight in place for engine tests and releases it for launch. We build it to match the vehicle’s restraints, cooling and control systems.

Explore TB30 ↗

Overview

The launch table combines engine testing, thrust measurement, vehicle restraints, and launch rehearsals.

Infrastructure State Ground Test Capability
Primary Role Starlight Launch + Testing
Supported Programs Hopper / Starlight
Primary UseIntegrated Ground Test Operations
Campaign TypesHot Fire / Hold Down / Rehearsal
Core FunctionsRestraint / Data / Plume Management
Supported HardwareEngines / Vehicles / Ground Systems
Program OutputTest Data / Operations Validation

Launch Table Systems

01 / RESTRAINT

Engine Cage

Secures test hardware and provides access for mounting and instrumentation.

02 / DATA

DAQ System

Records pressure, temperature, thrust, valve state, and timing in real time.

03 / HOLD DOWN

Hold Down Clamps

Restrains the vehicle during static tests and validates controlled release.

04 / FLAME DIVERTER + SOUND SUPPRESSION

Flame Diverter + Sound Suppression

Manage heat and acoustic loads to protect stand hardware.
